device: default capture device of the reference machine (owner USB microphone)
protocol: Recorder benchmarks/p1-audio (selftest drift --minutes 15), release build of the stage/8-fixes sources. Room silent, nobody at the PC, GPU idle (1.5 GB used by the desktop). Run 1 default settings, run 2 with --mic-buffer-ms 100 --mic-mmcss (the knobs behind BBB_MIC_TUNING=buffer100,mmcss), back to back. Only counts and timings are kept; the microphone audio was deleted by the harness and no content was read.
result: no effect: 5 flags in 15 min in both runs (0.33 per minute; the 10 h soak had 0.32 per minute). Audio stayed continuous in both runs (stored length 900.07 s and 900.00 s, no silence filled, continuity ok, worst packet gap 11.7 and 10.1 ms).
limits: One run per condition; with about 5 flags per run a difference of 1 to 2 flags is within noise, but a removal of the flags (the criterion of WP-13) would have shown as 0.
recommendation: Do not make the tuning the default. Keep it available as an opt-in experiment. Accept rec-dropped for the microphone (driver or USB clock adjustment: flags with no audible or measurable loss, no silence fill, continuous length) with --accepted and document it in LIMITATIONS (done).
